verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is documented as running untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs. MicroVMs imply virtualization-level (hardware) isolation, and the docs separately describe the environments as ephemeral, which covers the disposable part. The evidence is short first-party marketing-level sentences only. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the isolation model (no explicit hardware-virtualization statement), sandbox lifecycle and teardown details (creation API, timeouts, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
